It is here so e2e/schema_conformance.rb can validate this origin's LIVE HTTP bytes against the PUBLISHED schema with no second checkout and no network fetch. Identical to the upstream copy as PARSED JSON once this $comment is removed.
title: Kiosk event
description: One message the operator pushes on the event stream at <endpoint>/events. The root is CLOSED: an event carries the five members declared here. The topic's `payload_schema` in the catalog gives the shape of `data`.

id.description: A per-origin monotonic integer, at most 2^53 - 1, which a subscriber presents as `since`. It names one event in ONE identity's stream, not the change behind it. Delivery is at-least-once: a subscriber MUST ignore an id it has already seen.

topic.description: The topic this event belongs to, as declared in the catalog.

subject.description: What the event is ABOUT within the topic -- an order id, a list id. Null for a topic that has no subject. A subject-scoped subscription sees only its own.

occurred_at.description: When the operator's state actually changed, RFC 3339 in UTC. Not when the message was delivered: a replayed event carries the time of the transition, which is what a subscriber reasons about.

data.description: The payload, validating against the topic's payload_schema.
